sources.title: COCESNA eAIP: CA-4 visa-homologation schedule and Honduras scope
sources.publisher: Central American Corporation for Air Navigation Services (COCESNA), eAIP
sources.officialityEvidence: The live intergovernmental eAIP identifies the CA-4 schedule and says entry-visa type for Honduras depends on passport type, while publishing only named categories.
sources.supportingExcerpt: El tipo de visa ... para ingresar ... a Honduras ... dependerá del tipo de pasaporte.

sources.title: Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Honduras Immigration live visitor guidance directs non-CA-4 tourists to apply the CA-4 visa type; it does not publish a current per-nationality residual schedule or issuance outcome.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Se debe tener en cuenta el tipo de visa de turista a solicitar de acuerdo al CA-4.

sources.title: Honduras eAIP: immigration entry requirements
sources.publisher: Central American Corporation for Air Navigation Services (COCESNA), Honduras eAIP
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Honduras eAIP records that consular or consulted visas apply only where appropriate; it has no nationality map for the omitted or ambiguous ordinary passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: visa consular o consultada cuando corresponda
